configurationTypes.description: Source and import choices for the transfer-config command.
Source and date-window choices shared by event and speed transfers.
Choices for the combined upgrade-to-5 flow.

TransferConfigCommandConfiguration.Source: Connection string for the ATSPM 4.3 SQL Server source (--source).
TransferConfigCommandConfiguration.Delete: Delete target configuration data before importing (--delete).
TransferConfigCommandConfiguration.UpdateLocations: Import configuration and location data into the target (--update-locations; enabled by default).
TransferConfigCommandConfiguration.ImportSpeedDevices: Import speed-device configuration, not speed events (--update-speed; enabled by default).

MigrationCommandConfiguration.Source: Connection string for the ATSPM 4.3 SQL Server source (--source).
MigrationCommandConfiguration.Start: Start date and time for event or speed transfer (--start).
MigrationCommandConfiguration.End: Inclusive end for event or speed transfer; a date-only value includes the full end day (--end).
MigrationCommandConfiguration.Device: Limit event location selection to one ATSPM DeviceTypes integer; normally omit (--device).
MigrationCommandConfiguration.Batch: Compressed-window insert batch size for event transfer, maximum 600 (--batch).

UpgradeTo5CommandConfiguration.Source: Connection string for the ATSPM 4.3 SQL Server source; may also come from this configuration section (--source).
UpgradeTo5CommandConfiguration.Start: Start date and time for event and speed migration; may also come from this configuration section (--start).
UpgradeTo5CommandConfiguration.End: Inclusive end; a date-only value includes the full end day; may also come from this configuration section (--end).
UpgradeTo5CommandConfiguration.Delete: Delete target configuration data before importing (--delete).
UpgradeTo5CommandConfiguration.UpdateLocations: Import configuration and location data into the target (--update-locations; enabled by default).
UpgradeTo5CommandConfiguration.ImportSpeedDevices: Import speed-device configuration, not speed events (--update-speed; enabled by default).
UpgradeTo5CommandConfiguration.Device: Limit event location selection to one ATSPM DeviceTypes integer; normally omit (--device).

logMessages.description: Literal and interpolated ILogger call sites in migration services. Ordinary calls have no declared event ID; runtime-computed messages are omitted.
